title: EMRAS Theme 1 Working Group 2 soybean scenario, experiments SB1-SB6
license: IAEA publication; attribution required and publication-specific reuse permission not established for repackaging tables
redistribution_allowed: No raw data redistribution; cite source only
process: leaf HTO uptake, depuration, OBT formation and translocation
variables: air HTO; temperature; relative humidity; radiation; rainfall; wind/stability; plant-body and pod TFWT/OBT
time_resolution: 5 min during exposure; irregular plant samples from 0.2 h to harvest; supporting outdoor meteorology resolution not available in retrieved report
units: air and plant activity Bq L-1; temperature degC; RH percent; radiation W m-2 or klux
uncertainty: plant tritium measurement about 10 percent; other sources not quantified
completeness: Scenario description and observation tables are public, but the two supporting meteorology workbooks and most glove-box air workbooks are only described as available from organizers; chamber mixing condition is not specified
applicability: High process relevance to leaf uptake and depuration; incomplete forcing prevents a reproducible formal run
rejection_reason: Missing organizer Excel files, complete post-exposure meteorology, chamber mixing or wind characterization, and reported detection limit

title: EMRAS Pickering atmospheric tritium scenario
license: IAEA publication; attribution required and publication-specific reuse permission not established for repackaging tables
redistribution_allowed: No raw data redistribution; cite source only
variables: release; air; precipitation; soil; vegetation; food and dose endpoints
uncertainty: measurement and model uncertainty discussed but no uniform machine-readable uncertainty series
completeness: Report contains scenario definitions, plots and selected tables; complete matched raw time series and forcing package was not located
applicability: Useful model-comparison context but not a complete matched air-soil-plant validation package for the current runner
rejection_reason: No complete machine-readable same-site time series with checksum, uncertainty and detection-limit metadata
